description:
The Dr. Brown’s Specialty Feeding System is a unique bottle/nipple/valve system designed specifically to assist in the management and treatment of complicated oral feeding issues. This bottle system will be beneficial for infants and bottle-fed children identified with severe to profound difficulty in efficiently expressing a fluid bolus during sucking. Infants with the following conditions – cleft lip/palate, oro-neuromotor dysfunctions, congenital heart disease, common or rare syndromic sequences and/or craniofacial anomalies will demonstrate strong outcomes while using the Dr. Brown’s Specialty Feeding System. The unidirectional flow valve known as the “Infant-Paced Feeding Valve” is inserted into the silicone nipple at the nipple base and placed into the collar. Once full assembly of the Dr. Brown’s Specialty Feeding System is complete this system allows the infant to use their own tongue and jaw movements during sucking to adequately express and deliver a fluid bolus into their intra-oral space for safe and efficient swallowing. The feeding becomes “infant-directed” and allows the infant to feed safely, efficiently and successfully. The Dr. Brown’s Natural Flow bottle is fully vented to create a positive-pressure flow for vacuum-free feeding. As baby feeds, fluid enters the infant’s mouth and air is channeled back from the infant through the nipple and the vent system bypassing the breast milk or formula during feeding. This system prevents the negative effects of a vacuum, allowing babies to feed more comfortably and eliminating discomfort from ingesting air, thereby reducing the symptoms of colic, spit-up, burping and gas. Includes 2-8oz bottles, valve, 2-Level 1 silicone nipples, 2-Level 2 silicone nipples, cleaning brush. (Fast flow nipples are for more developed feeders). (Nipple size may vary).

نظام التغذية المتخصص من دكتور براون هو نظام فريد من نوعه للزجاجة/الحلمة/الصمام مصمم خصيصًا للمساعدة في إدارة وعلاج مشاكل التغذية الفموية المعقدة. سيكون نظام الزجاجات هذا مفيدًا للرضع والأطفال الذين يتغذون من الزجاجات الذين يعانون من صعوبة شديدة إلى عميقة في التعبير عن مسمار سائل أثناء الشفط. الأطفال الذين يعانون من الحالات التالية - الشفة/الحلق المشقوق، اختلال في الحركة العصبية، ومرض القلب التناسقي أو المتسلسلات الشائعة أو النادرة و/أو شوائب العمود الفقري ستظهر نتائج قوية أثناء استخدام نظام التغذية المتخصص من دكتور براون. يتم إدخال صمام التدفق أحادي الاتجاه المعروف باسم "صمام تغذية الرضع" في حلمة السيليكون في قاعدة الحلمة ووضعه في الطوق. بمجرد اكتمال التجميع الكامل لنظام التغذية المتخصص من دكتور براون، يسمح هذا النظام للطفل باستخدام حركات اللسان والفك الخاصة به أثناء الشفط للتعبير بشكل مناسب عن طريق الفم وتوصيل بوليوس سائل في مساحته الداخلية من أجل ابتلاع آمن وفعال. تصبح الرضاعة "موجهة للرضع" وتسمح للطفل بالتغذية بأمان وكفاءة ونجاح. زجاجة ناتشورال فلو من دكتور براون جيدة التهوية بالكامل لخلق تدفق ضغط إيجابي لتغذية خالية من الشفط. عندما يرضع الطفل، يدخل السائل فم الطفل ويصدر الهواء مرة أخرى من الطفل من خلال الحلمة ونظام التهوية يتجاوز حليب الثدي أو التركيبة أثناء الرضاعة. يمنع هذا النظام التأثيرات السلبية للمكنسة الهوائية، مما يسمح للأطفال بالتغذية بشكل أكثر راحة والتخلص من عدم الراحة من ابتلاع الهواء، وبالتالي تقليل أعراض المغص والبصق والتجشؤ والغازات. تتضمن زجاجات بسعة 2 - 8 أونصة، وصمام، وحلمات سيليكون من مستويين 1، وحلمات سيليكون من المستوى 2، وفرشاة تنظيف. (حلمات التدفق السريع مخصصة لمغذيات أكثر تطورًا). (قد يختلف حجم الحلمة).

O sistema de alimentação especial Dr. Brown é um sistema exclusivo de mamadeira/mamilo/válvula projetado especificamente para ajudar no gerenciamento e tratamento de problemas complicados de alimentação oral. Este sistema de mamadeira será benéfico para bebês e crianças alimentadas por mamadeira identificadas com dificuldade severa a profunda em expressar eficientemente um bolus fluido durante a sucção. Crianças com as seguintes condições – fissura labial/palato, disfunções oro-neuromotoras, doença cardíaca congênita, sequências síndromicas comuns ou raras e/ou anomalias craniofaciais demonstrarão resultados fortes ao usar o sistema de alimentação especial Dr. Brown. A válvula de fluxo unidirecional conhecida como "válvula de alimentação infantil" é inserida no bico de silicone na base do bico e colocada na gola. Quando a montagem completa do sistema de alimentação especial Dr. Brown estiver completa, este sistema permite que o bebê use seus próprios movimentos de língua e mandíbula durante a sucção para expressar adequadamente e proporcionar um bolus fluido em seu espaço intra-oral para uma deglutição segura e eficiente. A alimentação torna-se "direcionada para bebês" e permite que a criança se alimente com segurança, eficiência e sucesso. O frasco de fluxo natural Dr. Brown é totalmente ventilado para criar um fluxo de pressão positiva para alimentação sem vácuo. À medida que o bebê se alimenta, o fluido entra na boca do bebê e o ar é canalizado de volta do bebê através do mamilo e o sistema de ventilação que contorna o leite materno ou a fórmula durante a alimentação. Este sistema evita os efeitos negativos de um vácuo, permitindo que os bebês se alimentem de forma mais confortável e eliminando o desconforto de ingerir ar, reduzindo assim os sintomas de cólicas, arrotos e gases. description: Our insulated stainless steel baby feeding bottles keep hot or cold up to six hours. They are a healthy and eco-friendly baby thermos for mothers when going out, traveling, or for late-night bedside feeding. Our German-made anti-colic nipples are also great, shaped similar to a mother's breast. These are also very good breastfeeding bottles, holding breast milk for up to eight hours. Great baby gift for baby showers. REGARDING THERMOS FUNCTION: Please note that our bottles function like all thermoses. The greatest heat loss is within the first 2 hours, and then heat reduction slows down greatly. We recommend putting water hot enough for tea in initially (about 185F / 85C), then after 2 hours it should be around 125F / 50C. After 6 hours it should then be about 110F / 45C - warm enough to still make formula. Also filling the bottle with water will slow the temperature drop - leaving air in the bottle speeds up temperature drop. You can adjust your starting heat based on when you think you'll use the bottle - e.g. if you plan to use it in one hour, no need to put 125F / 85C water inside initially!

A healthy pregnant and/or breastfeeding woman needs to consume 90+ ounces of water a day. So, you just need to refill and drink the drink more water, make more milk bottle three times every 24 hours.

BROS is a Malaysian brand that started small in year 2004, but have since blossomed and spread across the region and internationally. description: Our insulated stainless steel baby feeding bottles keep hot or cold up to ten hours. Our German-made anti-colic nipples are also great, shaped similar to a mother's breast. These are also very good breastfeeding bottles, holding breast milk for up to eight hours. Great baby gift for baby showers. REGARDING THERMOS FUNCTION: Please note that our bottles function like all thermoses. The greatest heat loss is within the first 2 hours, and then heat reduction slows down greatly. We recommend putting water hot enough for tea in initially (about 185F / 85C), then after 2 hours it should be around 125F / 50C. After 8 hours for our 7 oz it should then be about 110F / 45C - warm enough to still make formula. The time frame for our 4 oz bottles is 6 hours. Also filling the bottle with water will slow the temperature drop - leaving air in the bottle speeds up temperature drop. You can adjust your starting heat based on when you think you'll use the bottle - e.g. if you plan to use it in one hour, no need to put 125F / 85C water inside initially!

Fully reusable system]
description:
The Dr. Brown's Specialty Feeding System is a unique bottle/nipple/valve system designed specifically will be beneficial for infants and bottle-fed children identified with severe to profound difficulty in efficiently expressing a fluid bolus during sucking. Infants with the following conditions - cleft lip/palate, oro-neuromotor dysfunctions, congenital heart disease, common or rare syndromic sequences and/or craniofacial anomalies will demonstrate strong outcomes while using the Dr. Brown's Specialty Feeding System. The unidirectional flow valve known as the “Infant-Paced Feeding Valve" is inserted into the silicone nipple at the nipple base and placed into the collar. Once full assembly of the Dr. Brown's Specialty Feeding System is complete this system allows the infant to use their own tongue and jaw movements during sucking to adequately express and deliver a fluid bolus into their intra-oral space for safe and efficient swallowing. The feeding becomes “infant-directed" and allows the infant to feed safely, efficiently and successfully. The Dr. Brown's Natural Flow bottle is fully vented to create a positive-pressure flow for vacuum-free feeding. As baby feeds, fluid enters the infant's mouth and air is channeled back from the infant through the nipple and the vent system bypassing the breast milk or formula during feeding. This system prevents the negative effects of a vacuum, allowing babies to feed more comfortably and eliminating discomfort from ingesting air, thereby reducing the symptoms of colic, spit-up, burping and gas.

TIPS: If the Specialty Feeding System is leaking: 1) the collar may be either too tight or too loose; or 2) the insert and reservoir may not be properly assembled. It is not recommended to mix formula in the bottle as the shaking may cause the internal vent system to separate and the bottle to leak. Use only Dr. Brown’s nipples specifically for the Specialty Feeding System – nipples included with bottles or replacement nipple pack.

description: Our insulated stainless steel baby feeding bottles keep hot or cold up to ten hours. They are a healthy and eco-friendly baby thermos for mothers when going out, traveling, or for late-night bedside feeding. Our German-made anti-colic nipples are also great, shaped similar to a mother's breast. These are also very good breastfeeding bottles, holding breast milk for up to eight hours. Great baby gift for baby showers. REGARDING THERMOS FUNCTION: Please note that our bottles function like all thermoses. The greatest heat loss is within the first 2 hours, and then heat reduction slows down greatly. We recommend putting water hot enough for tea in initially (about 185F / 85C), then after 2 hours it should be around 125F / 50C. After 8 hours for our 7 oz it should then be about 110F / 45C - warm enough to still make formula. The time frame for our 4 oz bottles is 6 hours. Also filling the bottle with water will slow the temperature drop - leaving air in the bottle speeds up temperature drop. You can adjust your starting heat based on when you think you'll use the bottle - e.g. if you plan to use it in one hour, no need to put 125F / 85C water inside initially!

description:
The Dr. Brown's Specialty Feeding System is a unique bottle/nipple/valve system designed specifically will be beneficial for infants and bottle-fed children identified with severe to profound difficulty in efficiently expressing a fluid bolus during sucking. Infants with the following conditions - cleft lip/palate, oro-neuromotor dysfunctions, congenital heart disease, common or rare syndromic sequences and/or craniofacial anomalies will demonstrate strong outcomes while using the Dr. Brown's Specialty Feeding System. The unidirectional flow valve known as the “Infant-Paced Feeding Valve" is inserted into the silicone nipple at the nipple base and placed into the collar. Once full assembly of the Dr. Brown's Specialty Feeding System is complete this system allows the infant to use their own tongue and jaw movements during sucking to adequately express and deliver a fluid bolus into their intra-oral space for safe and efficient swallowing. The feeding becomes “infant-directed" and allows the infant to feed safely, efficiently and successfully. The Dr. Brown's Natural Flow bottle is fully vented to create a positive-pressure flow for vacuum-free feeding. As baby feeds, fluid enters the infant's mouth and air is channeled back from the infant through the nipple and the vent system bypassing the breast milk or formula during feeding. This system prevents the negative effects of a vacuum, allowing babies to feed more comfortably and eliminating discomfort from ingesting air, thereby reducing the symptoms of colic, spit-up, burping and gas.

description:
ABOUT BROS:
BROS is a Malaysian brand that started in year 2004, but have since blossomed and spread across the region and internationally. When we first started, we were only selling single-coloured water bottles, but we believed that reusable water bottles can do much more. So a year later, we had an idea to print fun designs and inspiring messages onto our bottles, transforming this daily necessity into an accessory of style. BROS pushed the limit of traditional canvas and transformed our bottles into a medium to celebrate art. Until now, we are still telling stories through our products, putting more emphasis on the narratives we share in our design. It was contagious, and we have not stopped since. Our passion for creative, functional and premium quality products brought us forward; resulting with us bringing more varieties of household products to the market, ranging from our ever-growing water bottle series to food containers.

BROS CARES:
- All BROS product materials and its actual units are tested safe. Complying with FDA health standards.
- Avoid filling the bottle with liquid exceeding 203°F/95°C in temperature.
- We highly recommend hand washing to maximize the life span of the bottle. For daily cleaning, rinse both bottle cap and bottle with running water. Drain downward and leave it opens to dry. For thorough cleaning, you can use soapy water with a soft brush.
- BROS products are dishwasher safe with water temperature below 203°F/95°C. Make sure all parts of the bottle are not in contact with the dishwasher heating element or it will melt.
- We strongly discourage sterilizing BROS bottle as the material used to produce the bottle can only withstand heat up to 203°F/95°C.
- BROS suggests : Replace the bottle when there are scratches on the inner surface of the bottle or when it becomes cloudy, discolored or cracked.

Great baby gift for baby showers. REGARDING THERMOS FUNCTION: Please note that our bottles function like all thermoses. The greatest heat loss is within the first 2 hours, and then heat reduction slows down greatly. We recommend putting water hot enough for tea in initially (about 185F / 85C), then after 2 hours it should be around 125F / 50C. After 8 hours for our 7 oz it should then be about 110F / 45C - warm enough to still make formula. The time frame for our 4 oz bottles is 6 hours. Also filling the bottle with water will slow the temperature drop - leaving air in the bottle speeds up temperature drop. You can adjust your starting heat based on when you think you'll use the bottle - e.g. if you plan to use it in one hour, no need to put 125F / 85C water inside initially!

description: Dr. Brown's bottle features a patented two-piece internal vent system that works unlike any other bottle design. The vent system fully vents our bottle for vacuum free feeding, which we call positive-pressure flow, similar to breastfeeding. As the baby feeds, air is channeled from the nipple collar through the vent system, bypassing the breast milk or formula, to the back of the bottle. description:
ABOUT BROS:
BROS is a Malaysian brand that started in year 2004, but have since blossomed and spread across the region and internationally. When we first started, we were only selling single-coloured water bottles, but we believed that reusable water bottles can do much more. So a year later, we had an idea to print fun designs and inspiring messages onto our bottles, transforming this daily necessity into an accessory of style. BROS pushed the limit of traditional canvas and transformed our bottles into a medium to celebrate art. Until now, we are still telling stories through our products, putting more emphasis on the narratives we share in our design. It was contagious, and we have not stopped since. Our passion for creative, functional and premium quality products brought us forward; resulting with us bringing more varieties of household products to the market, ranging from our ever-growing water bottle series to food containers.

BROS CARES:
- All BROS product materials and its actual units are tested safe. Complying with FDA health standards.
- Avoid filling the bottle with liquid exceeding 203°F/95°C in temperature.
- We highly recommend hand washing to maximize the life span of the bottle. For daily cleaning, rinse both bottle cap and bottle with running water. Drain downward and leave it opens to dry. For thorough cleaning, you can use soapy water with a soft brush.

مع زجاجة الأطفال كلوزر تو ناتشر الحائزة على جوائز أصبح التبديل بين الرضاعة الطبيعية والزجاجة أسهل من أي وقت مضى. عند البحث عن زجاجة هي أفضل شيء لك، هذه هي الزجاجة. مع السيليكون الناعم الذي يسمح للطفل بإحساس دفء الحليب والنعومة التي تشبه الثدي، سيشعر طفلك بالراحة عندما لا يكون خياراً.
للمساعدة في تجنب ارتباك الحلمة، تم تصميم حلمة الرضاعة الأكثر شبيهة بالصدر بواسطة خبراء الرضاعة الطبيعية لمحاكاة المرونة والتمدد والحركة الطبيعية لثدي الأم. تتميز حلمات زجاجة كلوزر تو ناتشر بصمام مضاد للمغص لمنع أعراض المغص من خلال ضمان ابتلاع طفلك الصغير المزيد من الحليب والهواء أقل.
مصنوعة من السيليكون الناعم، كما أن الحلمة تبدو أقرب إلى البشرة للحصول على راحة كاملة في وقت الرضاعة. إلى جانب الصمام الحساس للزجاجة، فإن رقبة الزجاجة العريضة تشجع على التغذية البديهية لطفلك. مصممة ليتم حملها في الوضع الأكثر طبيعية أثناء الرضاعة، كما أن الشكل المدمج للزجاجة يسمح للطفل أن يكون أقرب إليك.
تتوافق زجاجات السيليكون ذات الملمس الناعم فقط مع مجموعتنا من حلمات كلوزر تو نيتشر - المتوفرة في مجموعة من معدلات التدفق لمواكبة نمو طفلك. نوصي بتغيير حلمات الزجاجة كل شهرين أو إذا تعرضت للتلف أو ضعيف أو قضم الأسنان الصغيرة.
يحافظ طلاء السيليكون المضاد للكهرباء الساكنة على نظافة الزجاجة عن طريق طرد جزيئات الغبار ولن يحتفظ بأي بقع أو روائح تتركها حليب الثدي أو التركيبة. الزجاجة ذات الرقبة العريضة تجعل التنظيف سهلاً، كما أن الزجاجات مناسبة للاستخدام في غسالة الأطباق والميكروويف والتعقيم ومدفئات الزجاجات. سهلة التجميع ومضمونة بعدم التسرب عند إطعام طفلك بغطاء وقرص سفر متضمن لمنع الانسكابات أو التسربات أثناء التنقل. زجاجات الأطفال الخاصة بنا خالية من البيسفينول وبولي فينيل الكلورايد والفثالات من أجل طمأنينة مطلقة.

description: Our insulated stainless steel baby feeding bottles keep hot or cold up to ten hours. They are a healthy and eco-friendly baby thermos for mothers when going out, traveling, or for late-night bedside feeding. Our German-made anti-colic nipples are also great, shaped similar to a mother's breast. These are also very good breastfeeding bottles, holding breast milk for up to eight hours. Great baby gift for baby showers. REGARDING THERMOS FUNCTION: Please note that our bottles function like all thermoses. The greatest heat loss is within the first 2 hours, and then heat reduction slows down greatly. We recommend putting water hot enough for tea in initially (about 185F / 85C), then after 2 hours it should be around 125F / 50C. After 8 hours for our 7 oz it should then be about 110F / 45C - warm enough to still make formula. The time frame for our 4 oz bottles is 6 hours. Also filling the bottle with water will slow the temperature drop - leaving air in the bottle speeds up temperature drop. You can adjust your starting heat based on when you think you'll use the bottle - e.g. if you plan to use it in one hour, no need to put 125F / 85C water inside initially!

description:
Not all bottles were created equal. Bfree's flagship bottle with the patented air vent has helped millions of babies all over the world by making feeding easier than ever, helping prevent colic, gas and even ear infections. A significant problem many parents aren't aware of is vacuum, which forms in most baby bottles. Vacuum has been proven to be a major cause of gas, colic and even ear infections since it forces baby to suckle extra hard in order to extract milk from the bottle. Ear disease in infants can be associated with bottle feeding. When using standard baby feeding bottles that are non-ventilated or completely under-ventilated, the vacuum (negative pressure) which forms in them during a feeding may lead to development of secretory otitis causing hearing impairment and a risk for delayed speech development. Bfree has a patented air vent that helps prevent vacuum formation, helping baby to suckle comfortably and control the flow of milk, without causing pressure in the ear. This unique air vent is found in all Bfree bottles and cups and grows with your baby from age 0-3. Bfree was the first global brand to use the safe BPA free plastics. All Bfree bottles are made from strong, durable, safe and UV protective plastic. When food is too hot, the safety heat sensor changes color visibly on the inside of the bottle. Bfree glass bottles are made to withstand rapid temperature changes. They help maintain food temperature for longer and do not absorb odors and flavors and are very easy to clean. All bottles have a special sealing disk included so you can seal and store contents in either in the fridge or freezer for later use. Every part of the Bfree bottle can be used on any other Bfree bottle or cup

description:
Not all bottles were created equal. Bfree's flagship bottle with the patented air vent has helped millions of babies all over the world by making feeding easier than ever, helping prevent colic, gas and even ear infections. A significant problem many parents aren't aware of is vacuum, which forms in most baby bottles. Vacuum has been proven to be a major cause of gas, colic and even ear infections since it forces baby to suckle extra hard in order to extract milk from the bottle. Ear disease in infants can be associated with bottle feeding. When using standard baby feeding bottles that are non- ventilated or completely under-ventilated, the vacuum (negative pressure) which forms in them during a feeding may lead to development of secretory otitis causing hearing impairment and a risk for delayed speech development. Bfree has a patented air vent that helps prevent vacuum formation, helping baby to suckle comfortably and control the flow of milk, without causing pressure in the ear. This unique air vent is found in all Bfree bottles and cups and grows with your baby from age 0-3.
Bfree was the first global brand to use the safe BPA free plastics. All Bfree bottles are made from strong, durable, safe and UV protective plastic. Warns when feed is too hot, the safety heat sensor changes color visibly on the inside of the bottle.

Dr Brown's bottles use a patented 2-piece internal vent system for your baby's comfort. This system creates positive-pressure flow for vacuum-free feeding that is similar to breastfeeding. description: Our insulated stainless steel baby feeding bottles keep hot or cold up to ten hours. They are a healthy and eco-friendly baby thermos for mothers when going out, traveling, or for late-night bedside feeding. Our German-made anti-colic nipples are also great, shaped similar to a mother's breast. These are also very good breastfeeding bottles, holding breast milk for up to eight hours. Great baby gift for baby showers. REGARDING THERMOS FUNCTION: Please note that our bottles function like all thermoses. The greatest heat loss is within the first 2 hours, and then heat reduction slows down greatly. We recommend putting water hot enough for tea in initially (about 185F / 85C), then after 2 hours it should be around 125F / 50C. After 8 hours for our 7 oz it should then be about 110F / 45C - warm enough to still make formula. The time frame for our 4 oz bottles is 6 hours. Also filling the bottle with water will slow the temperature drop - leaving air in the bottle speeds up temperature drop. You can adjust your starting heat based on when you think you'll use the bottle - e.g. if you plan to use it in one hour, no need to put 125F / 85C water inside initially!

description:
The Dr. Brown's Natural Flow Standard Baby Bottles offer a wonderful feeding experience with innovative vent technology. Dr Brown's bottles use a patented 2-piece internal vent system for your baby's comfort. This system creates positive-pressure flow for vacuum-free feeding that is similar to breastfeeding. The breast milk or formula flows freely without nipple collapse. As the baby feeds, air is channeled from the nipple collar through the vent system to the back of the bottle. The vent system eliminates air bubbles in the formula or milk, which helps to reduce feeding problems like colic, spit-up, burping and gas. Dr. Brown's bottles are completely BPA, PVC, lead and phthalate free for your baby's safety. Each bottle comes with 1 Level-One silicone nipple, 1 two-piece patented internal vent system. 6 pk includes 1 cleaning brush and instructions.

مع زجاجة الأطفال كلوزر تو ناتشر الحائزة على جوائز أصبح التبديل بين الرضاعة الطبيعية والزجاجة أسهل من أي وقت مضى. عند البحث عن زجاجة هي أفضل شيء لك، هذه هي الزجاجة. مع السيليكون الناعم الذي يسمح للطفل بإحساس دفء الحليب والنعومة التي تشبه الثدي، سيشعر طفلك بالراحة عندما لا يكون خياراً.
للمساعدة في تجنب ارتباك الحلمة، تم تصميم حلمة الرضاعة الأكثر شبيهة بالصدر بواسطة خبراء الرضاعة الطبيعية لمحاكاة المرونة والتمدد والحركة الطبيعية لثدي الأم. تتميز حلمات زجاجة كلوزر تو ناتشر بصمام مضاد للمغص لمنع أعراض المغص من خلال ضمان ابتلاع طفلك الصغير المزيد من الحليب والهواء أقل.
مصنوعة من السيليكون الناعم، كما أن الحلمة تبدو أقرب إلى البشرة للحصول على راحة كاملة في وقت الرضاعة. إلى جانب الصمام الحساس للزجاجة، فإن رقبة الزجاجة العريضة تشجع على التغذية البديهية لطفلك. مصممة ليتم حملها في الوضع الأكثر طبيعية أثناء الرضاعة، كما أن الشكل المدمج للزجاجة يسمح للطفل أن يكون أقرب إليك.
تتوافق زجاجات السيليكون ذات الملمس الناعم فقط مع مجموعتنا من حلمات كلوزر تو نيتشر - المتوفرة في مجموعة من معدلات التدفق لمواكبة نمو طفلك. نوصي بتغيير حلمات الزجاجة كل شهرين أو إذا تعرضت للتلف أو ضعيف أو قضم الأسنان الصغيرة.
يحافظ طلاء السيليكون المضاد للكهرباء الساكنة على نظافة الزجاجة عن طريق طرد جزيئات الغبار ولن يحتفظ بأي بقع أو روائح تتركها حليب الثدي أو التركيبة. الزجاجة ذات الرقبة العريضة تجعل التنظيف سهلاً، كما أن الزجاجات مناسبة للاستخدام في غسالة الأطباق والميكروويف والتعقيم ومدفئات الزجاجات. سهلة التجميع ومضمونة بعدم التسرب عند إطعام طفلك بغطاء وقرص سفر متضمن لمنع الانسكابات أو التسربات أثناء التنقل. زجاجات الأطفال الخاصة بنا خالية من البيسفينول وبولي فينيل الكلورايد والفثالات من أجل طمأنينة مطلقة.
تشمل الجوائز: جوائز أفضل هدية للأطفال (2019) وجوائز المنتجات الوطنية للآباء (2019)
